gaps.explanation: pp5-6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints 15 fund columns; detail has budget schedules (pp17-22) only for General, Transportation, Economic Development, Lottery Trust, Natural Disaster and Offstreet Parking District No. 1. The p6 columns Police Reserve 1,278,000, Fire Reserve 0, Cemetery Reserve 9,777, Park and Recreation Reserve 3,556,891, Street Improvement 728,084, Special Sales Tax 7,398,562, Restaurant Occupation Tax Project 2,777,382, Public Safety TAB's 292,820 and General Obligation Bonds 663,484 (Total revenues) have no schedule: together 16,705,000, added row by row below. 31,428,067 + 16,705,000 = 48,133,067. The remaining -147,475 is basis: the scheduled funds' budget-basis (cash) receipts differ from their GAAP statement columns: General 25,584,264 (p17) vs 25,416,227 (p5) = +168,037; Transportation 4,946,856 (p18) vs 4,966,388 = -19,532; Lottery Trust 756,147 (p20) vs 753,883 = +2,264; Offstreet Parking 69,365 (p22) vs 72,659 = -3,294; Economic Development 71,435 = 71,435; net +147,475. 48,133,067 - 147,475 = 47,985,592 = statement Total Governmental Funds revenues (p6). The basis part needs no fix.
